thread:
Marta (CS): Hey team — quick Avalon onboarding healthcheck. They've started sending high-volume summarization jobs (avg ~700 tokens, bursty at day-end). We're seeing token cost spike and 95p latency creep to ~420ms. Renewal conversation in ~3 months. Can we propose low-risk perf changes we can push via config? TL;DR: quantized model + regional routing + prefix cache.

Sam (ML Eng): Thanks — do you have a sample request distribution or any failure cases? How sensitive are they to small quality deltas?

Marta (CS): Here: https://perfboard.internal/avalon/metrics (short link). They care most about extractive accuracy; small brevity increases are ok but hallucinations are unacceptable.

Sam (ML Eng): Proposed plan: 1) Canary compact-int8 model (compact-v1-int8) for 5% traffic with our prompt set. 2) Smart routing: route non-PII requests to us-west-2 to reduce cost while keeping latency similar. 3) Enable prefix KV caching for repeated prefixes. I can build rollout.

Julia (SRE): Ops notes: warm the dedicated pool before canary, schedule outside peak, and ensure automatic fallback to baseline model on errors. Also we need to adjust autoscale thresholds for warmup traffic.

Ken (PM): For renewal narrative we need an estimate of savings + risk mitigation language. Can we commit to a forecast (ballpark)? 20-30% cost reduction target would be compelling.

Sam (ML Eng): Quick eval on 200 in-domain samples: compact-v1-int8 -> ~24% token-cost reduction, median latency down ~120ms, ROUGE-style quality delta ~= -1.8% on avg. No major hallucination regressions in the sample. I'll upload eval artifacts.

Marta (CS): Avalon is open to a canary if we validate on their prompt set. Can someone draft rollout steps + success criteria? I'll book an enablement sync with the customer.

Sam (ML Eng): Draft rollout snippet:
```yaml
route_policy:
  - match: non_pii
    region: us-west-2
    weight: 0.6
  - match: default
    region: us-east-1
    weight: 0.4
canary:
  model: compact-v1-int8
  traffic_pct: 5
  evaluation_prompts: /datasets/avalon_eval.json
fallback: baseline-v1
```
(We'll run eval job and diff outputs automatically; canary auto-rolls back on quality_alerts.)

Julia (SRE): Ops checklist: monitor 95p latency, error rate, cache hit ratio, and model mismatch alerts. Rollback triggers: error_rate > 0.5% OR quality_alerts from eval harness. I'll add SLO dashboards and an alert runbook.

Marta (CS): Great. @Ken please get the cost/savings summary for the renewal package. I'll capture customer feedback in the enablement call. :thumbsup:

Ken (PM): On it — I'll produce a 90-day projection showing cost delta and a conservative savings band.

OpsBot: Proposed canary deployment window: Fri 22:00 UTC - Sat 01:00 UTC. Confirm with customer?

Evan (CS Manager): Avalon prefers off-peak windows, Friday works for them. I'll confirm exact timezone with their ops lead and update this thread.

Marta (CS): Perfect — once Evan confirms I'll queue the canary runbook and ask Sam to kick off the eval job. Thanks everyone.
